label: Nothing gives being that it does not have
paraphrase: OPEN analyst premise, attribution deferred: whatever causes the being of something that is in act as to being is itself in act as to being (CausesIn c x esse and InAct x esse imply InAct c esse). The esse instance of q.4 a.2 preexistence (STMT-PERFECTIONS-OF-EFFECT-PREEXIST-IN-CAUSE at r = esse), and the bottom rung of the 'nothing gives what it does not have' ladder: entailed by preexistence and by 'Whatever causes the being of anything is itself in act as to being' (both registered strength orders), strictly weaker than each (controls 12 and 13). 'Has' is the shared InAct, formally or eminently. A giver of being 'beyond being' (the Plotinian One read as lacking esse in every mode) would deny it; no claim on file states that reading for this InAct, so it is an unread lead with no weight; next test: read Enneads V.2.1 and check whether beyond being fails even the inclusive (eminent) InAct. CausesIn at esse is read for extrinsic (efficient) causes (prime-matter lead recorded on agency in act). No independent warrant is recorded for the maxim beyond its derivations from open premises.
